ops.title: udpipe-rs pulls ureq/rustls/ring unconditionally — accepted, not forked
ops.body: udpipe-rs 0.2.0 (the UDPipe C++ FFI binding used for the restored NLP layer) has NO cargo [features] — `ureq` 3.1 (→ rustls, ring, webpki) is a hard, non-optional dependency, pulled only for its `download_model` HTTP functions which cc-transcript never calls (the model ships embedded via include_bytes!, no runtime download). We accept this dead TLS/crypto stack rather than vendoring a stripped fork of udpipe-rs, because: (1) there is no deny.toml / cargo-deny / cargo-audit gate in CI, so nothing enforces removing it; (2) the added .so size is negligible next to the ~16MB embedded UDPipe model; (3) a vendored fork is itself ongoing maintenance surface, against the v13 goal of not maintaining parallel/forked codepaths. REVISIT (vendor udpipe-rs with ureq/dirs/download stripped, or upstream a `download` feature-gate) if a cargo-deny/deny.toml gate is ever added to CI, or if wheel size/build time becomes a problem.
